title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-123-25二模

items.zh: 学生通过参与科研项目接触到了前沿技术。
items.en: Students have exposure to cutting-edge technologies through participating in scientific research projects.

items.zh: 志愿者们用通俗易懂的语言帮助老年人提高金融素养。
items.en: The volunteers help the elderly improve their financial literacy by means of plain language.

items.zh: 本届音乐节的主题是“春天的律动”,这将为观众带来一场充满春天气息与艺术魅力的视听盛会。
items.en: The theme of this year’s music festival is “The Rhythm of Spring”, which will present the audience with a visual and auditory feast full of springtime and artistic charm.

items.zh: 智慧城市的智能管理不仅需要大数据分析，更依赖城市规划师、工程师和数据科学家的集思广益与推陈出新。
items.en: Intelligent management in smart cities not only requires big data analysis, but also relies on the collective wisdom and innovation of urban planners, engineers and data scientists.
